settings.name: addClass
settings.description: Add custom class for gallery container This can be used to set different style for different galleries

settings.name: allowMediaOverlap
settings.description: If true, toolbar, captions and thumbnails will not overlap with media element This will not affect thumbnails if animateThumb is false Also, toggle thumbnails button is not displayed if allowMediaOverlap is false Note - Changing the position of the media on every slide transition creates a flickering effect. Therefore, the height of the caption is calculated dynamically, only once based on the first slide caption. if you have dynamic captions for each media, you can provide an appropriate height for the captions via defaultCaptionHeight option

settings.name: appendCounterTo
settings.description: Where the counter should be appended

settings.name: appendSubHtmlTo
settings.description: control where the sub-html should be appended. If you choose '.lg-outer', you are responsible for placing the div at the right position. '.lg-outer' is useful if you want to show custom HTML outside the normal gallery

settings.name: ariaAnnouncements
settings.description: Announce slide changes to assistive technology through a dedicated polite live region (strings.slideAnnouncement + the slide caption). While enabled, the counter and caption bar are not separate live regions, the announcer is the single source of slide-change announcements. Set to false to restore the previous behavior (live counter and caption, no announcer). See Accessibility.

settings.name: ariaDescribedby
settings.description: aria-describedby attribute for gallery

settings.name: ariaLabelledby
settings.description: aria-labelledby attribute for gallery

settings.name: backdropDuration
settings.description: Backdrop transition duration. Note - Do not change the value of backdrop via css.

settings.name: closable
settings.description: If false user won't be able to close the gallery at all This is useful for creating inline galleries.

settings.name: closeOnTap
settings.description: allows clicks on black area to close gallery.

settings.name: container
settings.description: Configure where the gallery should be appended. Useful to create inline galleries and more It is an empty string in the default settings and later assigned to document.body to avoid accessing document for SSR

settings.name: controls
settings.description: If false, prev/next buttons will not be displayed.

settings.name: counter
settings.description: Whether to show total number of images and index number of currently displayed image.

settings.name: defaultCaptionHeight
settings.description: Height of the caption for calculating allowMediaOverlap positions Note - this is only used to find the position of media item if allowMediaOverlap is true. Not for setting height of the captions Set 0 if you want to calculate the height of captions dynamically

settings.name: direction
settings.description: Gallery reading direction: keyboard arrows, swipe advance and the slide/thumbnail transforms follow it. Visual mirroring is the opt-in lg-rtl.css layer - load it whenever this resolves to 'rtl'. 'auto' inherits the computed direction of the gallery element; the default stays 'ltr' so upgrades never change behavior on existing pages. See Localization & RTL.

settings.name: download
settings.description: Enable download button. By default download url will be taken from data-src/href attribute but it is supported only in modern browsers. If you want you can provide another url for download via data-download-url. pass false in data-download-url if you want to hide download button for the particular slide.

settings.name: dynamic
settings.description: lightGallery can be instantiated and launched programmatically by setting this option to true and populating dynamicEl option (see below) with the definitions of images.

settings.name: dynamicEl
settings.description: An array of objects (src, iframe, subHtml, thumb, poster, responsive, srcset sizes) representing gallery elements.

settings.name: easing
settings.description: Slide animation CSS easing property

settings.name: enableDrag
settings.description: Enables desktop mouse drag support

settings.name: enableSwipe
settings.description: Enables swipe support for touch devices

settings.name: escKey
settings.description: Whether the lightGallery could be closed by pressing the "Esc" key.

settings.name: exThumbImage
settings.description: Option to fetch different thumbnail image other than first image If you want to use external image for thumbnail, add the path of that image inside "data-" attribute and set value of this option to the name of your custom attribute.

settings.name: extraProps
settings.description: Fetch custom properties from the selector this is useful for plugin development By default lightGallery fetches and stores all the props selectors to reduce frequent dom interaction for fetching props every time. If you need any additional data to be fetched and stored in the galleryItems variable, you can do this just by passing the prop names via extraProps

settings.name: flickVelocity
settings.description: Release velocity (px/ms, measured over the gesture's final ~100ms) at which a short swipe still changes slides, a flick.

settings.name: getCaptionFromTitleOrAlt
settings.description: Option to get captions from alt or title tags.

settings.name: height
settings.description: Height of the gallery. example '100%' , '300px'

settings.name: hideBarsDelay
settings.description: Delay for hiding gallery controls in ms. Pass 0 if you don't want to hide the controls

settings.name: hideControlOnEnd
settings.description: If true, prev/next button will be hidden on first/last image. Note - this option will be ignored if loop or slideEndAnimation is set to true

settings.name: hideScrollbar
settings.description: Hide scrollbar when gallery is opened

settings.name: icons
settings.description: Custom icons: SVG markup per icon name, rendered instead of the built-in SVG icon set, bring your own icons without touching CSS. Omitted names keep the built-in icon. State-pair buttons (maximize/minimize, autoplayPlay/autoplayPause, fullscreen/fullscreenExit) need both names provided; a half-provided pair keeps the built-in pair. Size and color follow the button (1em/currentColor-friendly SVGs recommended). See Custom icons.

settings.name: iframeHeight
settings.description: Set height for iframe.

settings.name: iframeMaxHeight
settings.description: Set max height for iframe.

settings.name: iframeMaxWidth
settings.description: Set max width for iframe.

settings.name: iframeWidth
settings.description: Set width for iframe.

settings.name: index
settings.description: specify which slide should load initially

settings.name: isMobile
settings.description: Function to detect mobile devices

settings.name: keyPress
settings.description: Enable keyboard navigation

settings.name: licenseKey
settings.description: License key. lightGallery is free under the GPLv3; projects that keep their source proprietary need a commercial license, and its key arrives by email. Open-source projects can request a key at contact@lightgalleryjs.com. 0000-0000-000-0000 is a temporary key for evaluation: it does not limit any feature, it only logs a console warning. lightGallery 3 keys start with LIG; a key from v1 or v2 logs a warning asking you to upgrade. See License.

settings.name: loadYouTubePoster
settings.description: Automatically load poster image for YouTube videos

settings.name: loop
settings.description: If false, will disable the ability to loop back to the beginning of the gallery from the last slide.

settings.name: mobileSettings
settings.description: Separate settings for mobile devices Note - this is applied only at the time of loading by default controls and close buttons are disabled on mobile devices. use this option if you want to enable them or change any other settings for mobile devices Note - mobileSettings does not merge default values, you need to provide all mobileSettings including default values

settings.name: mode
settings.description: Type of transition between images.

settings.name: mousewheel
settings.description: ability to navigate to next/prev slides on mousewheel

settings.name: nextHtml
settings.description: Custom html for next control

settings.name: numberOfSlideItemsInDom
settings.description: Control how many slide items should be kept in dom at a time To improve performance by reducing number of gallery items in the dom, lightGallery keeps only the lowest possible number of slides in the dom at a time. This has a minimum value of 3

settings.name: pinchToClose
settings.description: Pinching down on an un-zoomed image and releasing closes the gallery (iOS Photos). Guarded: a pinch that went past fit zoom at any point is a zoom correction and never closes. Requires closable and the zoom plugin.

settings.name: plugins
settings.description: The plugins to enable for this gallery, as the constructors exported by each plugin entry, for example [lgZoom, lgThumbnail]. A plugin's settings do nothing until the plugin is listed here. See Plugins.

settings.name: preload
settings.description: number of preload slides will execute only after the current slide is fully loaded. for example, if you click on 4th image and if preload = 1 then 3rd slide and 5th slide will be loaded in the background after the 4th slide is fully loaded. if preload is 2 then 2nd 3rd 5th 6th slides will be preloaded.

settings.name: prevHtml
settings.description: Custom html for prev control

settings.name: resetScrollPosition
settings.description: Reset to previous scrollPosition when lightGallery is closed By default, lightGallery doesn't hide the scrollbar for a smooth opening transition. If a user changes the scroll position, lightGallery resets it to the previous value

settings.name: selector
settings.description: Custom selector property instead of direct children. Based on your markup structure, you can specify custom selectors to fetch media data for the gallery Pass "this" to select same element You can also pass HTMLCollection directly Example - '.my-selector' | '#my-selector' | this | document.querySelectorAll('.my-selector')

settings.name: selectWithin
settings.description: By default the selector element is relative to the current gallery. Instead of that you can tell lightGallery to select element relative to another element. Example - '.my-selector-container' | '#my-selector-container' In the code this becomes selector = document.querySelector(this.s.selectWithin).querySelectorAll(this.s.selector);

settings.name: showBarsAfter
settings.description: Delay in hiding controls for the first time when gallery is opened

settings.name: showCloseIcon
settings.description: If false, close button won't be displayed. Useful for creating inline galleries.

settings.name: showGestureButtons
settings.description: Show the toolbar buttons that repeat a touch gesture. Zoom in, zoom out and actual size do what pinch and double-tap already do. On by default, and turned off on touch devices through mobileSettings. See showGestureButtons.

settings.name: showMaximizeIcon
settings.description: Show maximize icon. Useful for creating inline galleries.

settings.name: slideDelay
settings.description: Delay slide transitions. This is useful if you want to do any action in the current slide before moving to next slide. For example, fading out the captions before going to next slide. .lg-slide-progress class name is added to the current slide immediately after calling the slide method. But transition begins only after the delay

settings.name: slideEndAnimation
settings.description: Enable slideEnd animation

settings.name: speed
settings.description: Transition duration (in ms).

settings.name: startAnimationDuration
settings.description: Zoom from image animation duration

settings.name: startClass
settings.description: Start animation class for the gallery. startClass will be empty if zoomFromOrigin is true. This can be used to change the starting effect when the image is loaded This is also applied when navigating to new slides

settings.name: subHtmlSelectorRelative
settings.description: Set to true if the selector in "data-sub-html" should use the current item as its origin.

settings.name: swipeThreshold
settings.description: By setting the swipeThreshold (in px) you can set how far the user must swipe for the next/prev image.

settings.name: swipeToClose
settings.description: allows vertical drag/swipe to close gallery false if option closable is false

settings.name: toolbarOverflow
settings.description: Keep the toolbar on one row. When the toolbar buttons do not fit beside the counter, the lowest-priority ones move into a "More options" menu. Set to false to let the buttons wrap onto a second row instead. See toolbarOverflow.

settings.name: trapFocus
settings.description: Trap focus within the lightGallery

settings.name: videoMaxSize
settings.description: Video max size. This can be over-written by passing specific size via data-lg-size attribute Recommended video resolution and aspect ratios https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6375112

settings.name: virtualization
settings.description: Large-gallery virtualization. Off when undefined, the classic behavior: every thumbnail renders and the mounted-slide window is numberOfSlideItemsInDom. slides overrides the mounted-slide pool size; thumbs turns on thumbnail-strip windowing (only the visible thumbs plus an overscan render, with spacers preserving the strip geometry), a number is the overscan thumb count per side, 'auto' derives one extra viewport per side. The window advances at commit points (release, slide change, resize), never per pointer move. See Virtualization.

settings.name: width
settings.description: Width of the gallery. example '100%' , '300px'

settings.name: zoomFromOrigin
settings.description: Enable zoom from origin effect. You need to know the original image size upfront and provide it via data-lg-size attribute as data-lg-size="1920-1280" If you don't know the size of a few images in the list, you can skip the data-lg-size attribute for the particular slides, lightGallery will show the default animation if data-lg-size is not available If you are using responsive images, you can pass a comma separated list of sizes combined with a max-width (up to what size the particular image should be used) example - data-lg-size="240-160-375, 400-267-480, 1600-1067" data-responsive="img-240.jpg 375, img-400.jpg 480" data-src="img-1600.jpg" In the above example, up to 375 width img-240.jpg and lg-size 240-160 will be used. Similarly, up to 480 pixel width size 400-267 and img-400.jpg will be used And above 480, lg-size 1600-1067 and img-1600.jpg will be used When the gallery closes on a slide that has no thumbnail to return to (the trigger is hidden or collapsed, as with the overflow items behind a "+9 photos" tile, it has no data-lg-size, or the gallery is dynamic), the slide shrinks to the centre of the stage and fades out instead of flying to the thumbnail. At the moment, the zoomFromOrigin option is supported only for image slides. The opening flight is skipped if dynamic option is enabled or galleryID found in the URL. startClass will be empty if zoomFromOrigin is true to avoid css conflicts.

settings.name: actualSize
settings.description: Enable actual size icon.

settings.name: actualSizeIcons
settings.description: Actual size icons classnames. Specify classnames for both ZoomIn and ZoomOut states You can use actualSizeIcons: { zoomIn: 'lg-actual-size', zoomOut: 'lg-zoom-out' } to show actual size icons instead of zoom in and zoom out icons.

settings.name: enableZoomAfter
settings.description: Once the slide transition is completed, how much time the zoom plugin should take to activate Some css styles will be added to the images if zoom is enabled. So it might conflict if you add any custom styles to the images such as the initial transition while opening the gallery. So you can delay adding zoom related styles to the images by changing the value of enableZoomAfter.

settings.name: infiniteZoom
settings.description: Enable/Disable infinite zoom If you set this to true, you can zoom in more than the original size of the image.

settings.name: scale
settings.description: Value by which zoom should be incremented/decremented

settings.name: showZoomInOutIcons
settings.description: Show zoom in, zoom out icons

settings.name: zoom
settings.description: Enable/Disable zoom option

settings.name: zoomPluginStrings
settings.description: Custom translation strings for aria-labels
settings.deprecated: Set these labels on the core strings object instead, every user-facing string lives in that one contract. An explicitly set key here still wins (alias).

settings.name: alignThumbnails
settings.description: Position of thumbnails when the width of all thumbnails combined is less than the gallery's width.

settings.name: animateThumb
settings.description: Enable thumbnail animation.

settings.name: appendThumbnailsTo
settings.description: control where the thumbnails should be appended. By default, thumbnails are appended to '.lg-components' which has inbuilt open close transitions If you don't want initial thumbnails transitions, or want to do more customization, you can append thumbnails to the lightGallery outer div - Demo

settings.name: currentPagerPosition
settings.description: Position of selected thumbnail.

settings.name: enableThumbDrag
settings.description: Enables desktop mouse drag support for thumbnails.

settings.name: enableThumbSwipe
settings.description: Enables thumbnail touch/swipe support for touch devices

settings.name: loadYouTubeThumbnail
settings.description: You can automatically load thumbnails for YouTube videos from YouTube by setting loadYouTubeThumbnail true

settings.name: scrubThumbnails
settings.description: Scrub the gallery with the thumbnail strip: while the strip is dragged (or gliding after a fling), the slide under the strip's travel position becomes current immediately, without slide transitions, the strip works like a scrubber instead of an independent scroll area. The full strip travel spans the whole gallery, so the first and last slides are always reachable. Requires animateThumb; taps still navigate normally. See Thumbnail scrubbing.

settings.name: thumbHeight
settings.description: Height of each thumbnail.

settings.name: thumbMargin
settings.description: Spacing between each thumbnail

settings.name: thumbnail
settings.description: Enable thumbnails for the gallery

settings.name: thumbnailPluginStrings
settings.description: Custom translation strings for aria-labels
settings.deprecated: Set these labels on the core strings object instead, every user-facing string lives in that one contract. An explicitly set key here still wins (alias).

settings.name: thumbnailSwipeThreshold
settings.description: By setting the thumbnailSwipeThreshold (in px) you can set how far the user must swipe for the next/prev slide.

settings.name: thumbWidth
settings.description: Width of each thumbnail.

settings.name: toggleThumb
settings.description: Enable toggle captions and thumbnails. not applicable if allowMediaOverlap is false

settings.name: youTubeThumbSize
settings.description: You can specify the thumbnail size by setting respective number.

settings.name: justified
settings.description: Enable the justified layout for the gallery's trigger thumbnails: rows of equal height and varying widths that fill the container edge to edge. Inline galleries only, dynamic mode has no trigger grid to lay out. Each box shows as a placeholder and its thumbnail fades in once loaded; put class="lg-justified" on the container markup so nothing shows unorganized before the script runs. See Justified layout.

settings.name: justifiedGap
settings.description: Gap between thumbnails and between rows (px).

settings.name: justifiedLastRow
settings.description: Last-row policy: 'justify' scales the leftover row to fill the width like every other row, 'start' keeps the row height aligned to the reading start, 'hide' hides the leftover thumbnails.

settings.name: justifiedMaxScale
settings.description: Row-height clamp as a multiple of justifiedRowHeight, a sparse row never renders taller than this.

settings.name: justifiedReveal
settings.description: How thumbnails appear as they load: 'row' reveals whole rows top to bottom, each once every thumbnail in it has loaded; 'image' reveals each thumbnail on its own as soon as it has loaded. Until a thumbnail is revealed its box shows as a placeholder. See Justified layout.

settings.name: justifiedRowHeight
settings.description: Row height (px) the layout aims for; actual rows land as close to it as the aspect ratios allow.

settings.name: autoplayFirstVideo
settings.description: Enable/Disable first video autoplay. Autoplay has to be managed using this setting. Autoplay in PlayerParams doesn't have any effect.

settings.name: autoplayVideoOnSlide
settings.description: Autoplay video on slide change Make sure you set preload:"none"

settings.name: gotoNextSlideOnVideoEnd
settings.description: Go to next slide when video is ended Note - this doesn't work with YouTube videos at the moment

settings.name: videoFacade
settings.description: Render provider video slides (YouTube/Vimeo/Wistia) as lite facades: a poster with a play button, with the provider iframe created only when the user presses play. The facade poster falls back from the item poster to the YouTube thumbnail endpoint (see loadYouTubePoster) to the item thumb; a slide with no resolvable poster keeps the previous eager-iframe behavior. Note autoplayFirstVideo/autoplayVideoOnSlide force an immediate materialize by design. Set false for 2.x eager-iframe behavior on all provider slides. See Video facades.

settings.name: videojs
settings.description: Enable videojs custom video player Dependency - You need to include videoJs on your document to enable videojs player

settings.name: videojsOptions

settings.name: videojsTheme

settings.name: youTubeNoCookie

settings.name: hashDriver

'auto' uses the Navigation API where the browser supports it and falls back to the History API everywhere else; 'history' and 'navigation' force an engine (an unsupported 'navigation' quietly falls back, the enhancement is never load-bearing). The deep-link URL format is identical either way. See Hash drivers.
